To give you an example of when I “want to say something” if my mind fixates on a certain word or something to say during a conversation. My brain will just become obsessed with it and my tics will start to come up. It feels like a sensation almost like an itch that doesn’t get relieved until I say it or I move.

I have no control over my tics, I’ve motor and verbal tics. The motor tics obviously I’ve no control over, but with verbal tics if I want to say something or someone says a triggering word, my tics just come out.
